job.education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
job.summary: We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to build and operate batch and streaming data pipelines for our retail analytics platform. The ideal candidate brings at least 5 years of experience, strong Python and SQL skills, and expertise in Apache Spark, Airflow, and AWS data services. Responsibilities include designing ETL/ELT pipelines, optimizing Spark jobs, and mentoring junior engineers.

experience.title: Data Engineer

structured_cv.summary: Priya Sharma is a Senior Data Engineer with 7 years of experience building data platforms for e-commerce and retail. She has expertise in developing PySpark pipelines on AWS, orchestrating data workflows with Apache Airflow, managing data warehouses in Redshift, and implementing data quality checks using dbt and Great Expectations. Priya also has hands-on experience with streaming ingestion via Kafka, Python, SQL, and infrastructure tools like Docker and Terraform. She holds a B.Tech in Computer Science from IIT Delhi.

strengths: Full coverage of must-have tech stack with deep hands-on AWS, PySpark, and Airflow experience
Exceeds experience requirements with 7 years of dedicated data engineering work
Direct retail and e-commerce domain experience demonstrated at ShopMart
Proven senior leadership capabilities through mentoring junior engineers and leading pipeline migrations
risks: Highly qualified candidate likely to command top-of-market compensation or multiple competing offers
ranked_candidates.explanation: Priya Sharma is an exemplary match for the Senior Data Engineer role, fulfilling 100% of the must-have requirements. She brings 7 years of relevant data engineering experience, exceeding the required 5-year threshold. Her work history at ShopMart directly aligns with the target retail analytics domain, featuring scale-tested PySpark pipelines handling 4 TB/day on AWS EMR. Additionally, she demonstrates hands-on proficiency with the required orchestration and warehousing stack, specifically Apache Airflow, Redshift, S3, and Glue. She also covers key nice-to-have tools including Kafka, dbt, Docker, and Terraform, along with explicit experience mentoring junior engineers. Her educational background of a B.Tech in Computer Science from IIT Delhi perfectly fulfills the degree criteria. Overall, she presents minimal hiring risk and is exceptionally well-positioned to step directly into the senior responsibilities.
ranked_candidates.calibration_note: Exceptional fit meeting all must-have requirements with 7 years of hands-on, high-scale retail data engineering experience.

strengths: Solid core data processing foundation in Python, SQL, Apache Spark, and AWS Redshift.
